description: Attention-pattern patching: make one head attend, at the last position, the way it did on the COUNTERFACTUAL prompt, and leave its values alone — so the question is 'does where this head looks carry the answer', separately from what it moves. `attention_probabilities` needs eager attention, and its last axis is each row's own keys, its tokens in order, so a pattern swapped from one prompt into another lines key k up with key k: the two must tokenize to the same length row by row; the run checks that before any forward (data/weekdays_aligned is the subset of pairs that do, under this tokenizer).
